purpose: Strategy registry for the NFL signal leaderboard. A 'strategy' is a mechanical, timestamped rule that grades every decision from committed data only. Strategies are proposals until they pass every validation gate; no strategy on this page is a claim of real-market profitability.
reward_principles: Rewards are leaderboard points and tier promotion only — never real-money payouts. This is a research competition, not a betting service.
Points reward SELECTIVE, VALIDATED skill: sample size, out-of-sample persistence, and luck-adjusted significance, capped so that one hot streak cannot win the season.
Strategies that fail a gate are demoted to 'unvalidated' and keep earning nothing until re-qualified on new data.

validation_gates.rule: Every graded decision must be reproducible from committed data files (research/nfl/raw sha256-verified snapshots) plus the strategy's timestamped rule text. No manual picks, no hindsight edits.
Provisional ranking requires ≥ 50 graded decisions; 'certified' tier requires ≥ 200. Below that, results are labelled SPEC and earn no points.
Hit-rate t-statistic vs the breakeven rate at the assumed price must reach t ≥ 2.0 (provisional) and t ≥ 2.5 with n ≥ 200 (certified). Zero-variance or sub-50-pick results are SPEC regardless of ROI.

Metrics must be computed on a held-out block (latest 30% of decisions) and must not degrade by more than 30% versus the fitting block. Single-season 2026 data cannot satisfy this yet — all current rows are therefore SPEC.
A decision may only use data published before kickoff (injury reports, depth charts, prior weeks' EPA). Any rule that references same-week outcomes is rejected at registration.

Multi-leg strategies must grade legs with correlation-adjusted joint probabilities (Bernoulli-covariance method, nfl-correlation.html) and cap same-game legs at 2. Uncorrelated-independence claims are rejected.

When a trusted market-reference feed is enabled (currently NOT ingested — see open question Q1), 'certified' status additionally requires median CLV ≥ 0 across ≥ 100 graded decisions. Until then no strategy can be 'certified' on CLV grounds.

scoring.luck_factor: max(0, min(1, t_stat / 2.5)) — zero credit below t = 0, full credit at t = 2.5
scoring.oos_factor: 0 if G4 unmeasurable, else min(1, oos_roi / fit_roi)
scoring.cap_note: ROI is capped at +25% per period so extreme small-sample streaks (see the 2026 in-sample simulation, S1: 90.3% on 31 picks vs an 84% outright-favourite baseline) cannot dominate the board. The cap is a research convention, flagged for review under Q-gates.

reward_tiers.requirement: G1-G6 passed, ≥ 200 decisions, t ≥ 2.5, OOS held
reward_tiers.reward: full points weight; top of leaderboard

reward_tiers.requirement: highest Certified points at season close
reward_tiers.reward: leaderboard champion entry + review priority for next season's model budget (non-monetary)

required_fields: legs (single | parlay; if parlay: leg list + correlation method)
registration_format.note: Registrations are JSON objects appended to data/nfl-analytics/strategies.json via a reviewed commit; the registry is append-only — rules are never edited after registration, replaced strategies get a new id.

starter_strategies.name: Model-favoured road chalk
starter_strategies.rule: Back the road team when the archived market line makes it a ≥ +3 favourite and the EPA-margin model projects the road side ≥ 2 after rest adjustment.
starter_strategies.status: SIMULATED in-sample weeks 1-9: 31 picks, 90.3% outright (baseline: 84% outright for this class in the same weeks) — SPEC; the model adds ~6pp over baseline, far below any significance bar

starter_strategies.name: Model-vs-market total under
starter_strategies.rule: Take the under when the archived market total ≥ 44 and the EPA total model projects ≤ market − 2.
starter_strategies.status: SIMULATED in-sample weeks 1-9: 32 picks, 62.5% (t = 1.74 < 2.0) — SPEC, promising but unproven

starter_strategies.name: OL-deficiency under
starter_strategies.rule: Take the under when either team lists ≥ 2 depth-1 offensive linemen as Out on the official weekly report.

starter_strategies.name: Secondary-deficiency over
starter_strategies.rule: Take the over when either defence lists ≥ 2 depth-1 secondary starters as Out.

starter_strategies.name: Rest-differential road side
starter_strategies.rule: Back the road team when it has ≥ 4 more rest days than home and the model projects ≥ −1 margin.

player_prop_policy: Player-prop combos are supported by the same gates. Prop baselines (usage, snap share, per-game distributions) come from committed snap-count and play-by-play snapshots; prop LINES are market data and are NOT ingested under the current official-only rule (open question Q1/Q7). Until prop lines are available, prop strategies can be registered and graded only on model-side probability estimates, which cannot pass G7 — they remain Spec tier.

sources.topic: Bookmaker pricing exploits bettor bias (favourites over-bet)
sources.note: summary of Levitt (2004), The Economic Journal 114(495), 223-246 — basis for G7 and for treating market lines as a reference, not truth
